title: W1 Additive migration: Space-scoped posts, wall settings, access rules, roster carry-over

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: Space circles become a Community wall; thread plan /mnt/project-files/community-wall/PLAN.md

detail: posts.scope_space_id (typed scope arc, derived from scope_id by sync_post_scope_arc, ON DELETE CASCADE); space_wall_settings (read anyone|members, post team|members, followers_interact; no row = defaults); private.can_read_space_wall, can_post_space_wall, can_moderate_space_wall (SECURITY DEFINER booleans); posts read, insert, update and delete policies learn the space scope with every existing arm confined to scope_space_id is null so a post cannot name a Space and bypass the wall; Space Circle roster rows become Space followers (idempotent; owner and staff skipped). Measured on production 2026-11-03: 41 Space Circles, 0 posts, 0 replies, 38 roster rows, 0 opt-outs, so there is nothing to copy; the re-key is the cutover (LIVE-2080). Migration 20270346028800, additive and idempotent, applied by this thread before merge (ADR-1111). Proof: supabase/tests/space_community_wall.test.sql.
